name: PHerc1203 at 2.4 µm (unlabelled)
segment: zones z965, z743, z031, 1203c (+ phase-3 tile p0_965)
summary: No reference read exists, so node A cannot run. Zones rendered from the 2.403 µm scan; models: native 2.4 µm hecate (scrollprize/hecate) and dense_native at 2.4 and 9.6 µm; null = same model on depth-reversed input. Caveat: the same pre-registered rule returns NOTHING on the PHerc. 343 region where letters were read (Nieuwlaar, Oct 2026; components 0.99-1.26x the depth-reversed null), so NO_CANDIDATE here is weak evidence of absence, not evidence of no ink.

notes: Rule as pre-registered in §0: components ≥ 2× reverse-depth null AND r ≥ 0.3 with a different checkpoint, then visual check (strokes 0.1–0.5 mm). Same-checkpoint agreement (dn@9.6 vs native dn) does not count.
Visual check (hires_test/fig/*_before_after.png): hecate fires in sparse spots at patch edges, dn@2.4 is uniform speckle; recorded as no stroke-like shapes.
Phase-3/4 tiles are still running; re-run examples/irp/export_1203.py and this card to include them.
unlabeled.compute: A full 1203 pass (≈ 23 cm², stride 128, both directions, plus the r152 teacher) is ≈ 72 h on this CPU box or an ESTIMATED 4–12 GPU-hours (≈ US$4–24); not justified without a candidate (hires_test/gpu_verdict.json).
